data.title: Muneeb Ali says Bitcoin has about two years to start its post-quantum upgrade
data.description: Bitcoin has a deadline problem, and Muneeb Ali wants everyone to start counting.Speaking at Token2049 Singapore on October 8, 2026, the Stacks co-founder said Bitcoin has roughly two years to upgrade, then about two more years to move coins before quantum computing risks intensify.Ali's keynote spl…
